title: docz-site Helm chart values
description: Guardrail schema for the docz-site chart. Constrains the handful of values that break the deployment when wrong (listen port, proxy target, service type) at helm install/upgrade/template time. Permissive elsewhere (additionalProperties) — it does not police the whole value surface.

mermaidLayout.description: Diagram layout engine. Constrained because the server falls back to elk on anything it does not recognize, so a typo here would otherwise be invisible — diagrams would simply keep rendering the default.

navLinks.description: Topbar nav pins rendered into DOCZ_NAV_LINKS as JSON.

logLevel.description: Log verbosity. Constrained because the server falls back to info on anything it does not recognize, so a typo here would otherwise be invisible — the deployment would simply keep logging at the default.

logFormat.description: Log output format: json for one object per line into an aggregator, text for readable local runs.

endpoint.description: OTLP/HTTP traces endpoint. Empty means tracing is off. Constrained to absolute http(s) URLs because this decides where request telemetry is sent — the server treats anything else as unset rather than guessing.

sampleRate.description: Head sample rate. The server clamps out-of-range values, but a schema rejection at install time is a better signal than a silent clamp.
